shared_elements: figures/motifs set in horizontal registers or bands
repeated arch- or scroll-like curved forms in a row
a hand or arm with articulated fingers
flattened, outline-based silhouettes against a cut-back ground
justification: Both are shallow relief-cut stone surfaces organised into horizontal registers, and both include a hand with separated fingers and rows of repeated curved, arch-like motifs, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a tall vertical block with a few isolated, widely spaced animal silhouettes on a blank ground, while B is a horizontal frieze crowded edge-to-edge with dense, finely stippled and interlocking curvilinear ornament, so the two differ fundamentally in density, orientation and manner of execution.
